items.headline: Messi's back in business — a first-half brace and a Leagues Cup record
items.body: Making his first start since winning the World Cup, Lionel Messi scored twice in the opening half to flip an early deficit as Inter Miami beat Liga MX's Atlético San Luis 4-2. They were his first goals since lifting the trophy — and they pushed him to 14 in Leagues Cup play, the most anyone has ever scored in the tournament.
items.say: Messi scored his first goals since winning the World Cup last night — a two-goal half in Miami's Leagues Cup opener, and he's now the all-time top scorer in that tournament. Guy just doesn't stop. You catch any of it?

items.headline: Football's officially back tonight — and the Colts just paid their star runner
items.body: The NFL preseason kicks off tonight with the Hall of Fame Game (Cardinals vs. Panthers in Canton, 8pm ET on NBC) — the first live football since the Super Bowl. It caps a busy day: Jonathan Taylor and the Colts agreed to a two-year, $44M extension, the richest third contract ever for an NFL running back, after he led the league in rushing touchdowns last season.
items.say: Football's actually back tonight — the Hall of Fame Game kicks off preseason. And the Colts just made Jonathan Taylor the highest-paid running back on a third contract ever. You ready for the season?

links.text: ESPN · Taylor, Colts agree to 2-year, $44M extension

items.headline: The Cubs swept the champs — and Ohtani's two homers weren't enough
items.body: Wrigley threw a party: the Cubs finished off a sweep of the two-time champion Dodgers with a 7-6 win, powered by Pete Crow-Armstrong's two homers and four RBIs and a Max Muncy three-run shot in a five-run eighth. Shohei Ohtani went deep twice himself (Nos. 25 and 26), but Chicago had the last word.
items.say: The Cubs just swept the Dodgers — Pete Crow-Armstrong hit two homers, and even Ohtani going deep twice couldn't save LA. Chicago's been a lot of fun this year. You follow baseball at all?

links.text: Dodgers vs. Cubs — Full Game Highlights (Aug 5, MLB)

items.headline: Meow — 'Super Troopers 3' hits theaters Friday, eight years later
items.body: The Broken Lizard gang is back on patrol: 'Super Troopers 3' opens Friday, with the original mustachioed crew reuniting when Farva's wildly over-the-top engagement collides with a brand-new drug ring. Brian Cox and Chace Crawford join the mayhem. It's been eight years since the last one, so the syrup-chugging cult comedy finally has a new chapter.
items.say: There's a Super Troopers 3 out Friday — first one in eight years. If you ever quoted 'meow' or the syrup bit, that's your weekend sorted. You a fan of those?

links.text: Boxoffice Pro · Super Troopers 3 kicks off August

items.headline: Karol G drops a new album Friday — with Drake and Bruno Mars along for the ride
items.body: The Colombian superstar releases her sixth album, 'No Me Arrepiento de Sentir Tanto' ("I Don't Regret Feeling So Much"), this Friday — and the just-revealed tracklist is stacked. Drake turns up on "Ahí" for their first official collab, Bruno Mars features on "Still," and Cigarettes After Sex's Greg Gonzalez closes it out. A big Latin-pop moment to cap the week's playlist.
items.say: Karol G's got a new album out Friday and the guest list is wild — Drake and Bruno Mars are both on it. It's gonna be everywhere this weekend. You into her stuff?

items.headline: The Walter Boys are back — Season 3 lands on Netflix today
items.body: Netflix's small-town romance juggernaut returns today with all 10 episodes of Season 3, picking up after that love-triangle bombshell and George's hospital scare. Jackie's caught between the Walter brothers again while Cole chases a racing dream and Alex takes up rodeo. Pure comfort-binge catnip for the YA crowd.
items.say: My Life with the Walter Boys just dropped its whole third season today — if you or the kids got hooked on that Netflix small-town romance, there you go. You watch it?

items.headline: The Buendías' final chapter — 'One Hundred Years of Solitude' Part 2 is streaming
items.body: Netflix's lavish adaptation of Gabriel García Márquez's masterpiece returned this week with Part 2, the back half of the sweeping Buendía family saga in Macondo. Seven episodes are streaming now, with a nearly feature-length grand finale still to come on August 26. Gorgeous, epic prestige TV if you want to sink into something.
items.say: The second half of Netflix's One Hundred Years of Solitude just came out — it's that beautiful adaptation of the famous novel. Great pick if you want something a bit epic. You read the book or catch season one?

items.headline: A 15-year-old just became the youngest Esports World Cup champ ever
items.body: One of the coolest stories in gaming right now: 15-year-old Chilean prodigy Jaime "Craime" Bustos won the Street Fighter 6 title at the Esports World Cup in Paris, dismantling Hibiki 5-2 in the grand final with a masterclass in patience and spacing — and banking $250,000. He's officially the youngest EWC champion in history.
items.say: A 15-year-old kid from Chile just won the Street Fighter title at that giant Esports World Cup — youngest champ ever, took home a quarter-million bucks. Pretty wild. You play any fighting games?
